title: swarm-do phase stage result
description: Stage result schema for controller-owned stages. The schema stays permissive for backward compatibility; controller validation is binding for unit-backed stages and requires result_path plus exact work_unit_id, worktree_path, bead_id, and allowed_files echoes when those values are present in the stage contract.

result_path.description: Required by controller validation for every controller-owned stage result.

work_unit_id.description: Permissive in schema for compatibility; required and matched by controller validation for unit-backed writer stages.

worktree_path.description: Permissive in schema for compatibility; required and matched by controller validation when the stage contract includes a unit worktree.

bead_id.description: Permissive in schema for compatibility; required and matched by controller validation when a stage bead is assigned.

allowed_files.description: Required and matched exactly by controller validation when the stage contract has allowed file scope.
